description: This file is a PHP source file that implements a server-side component for an AJAX-based tree loader in a TestLink project. It retrieves and formats hierarchical nodes related to requirements, requirement specifications, and other test management elements, generating JSON output for AJAX consumption.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class responsible for managing node types and hierarchical relationships within the test management structure.

methods.name: display_children
methods.description: Fetches and constructs child nodes for the AJAX tree, applying filters and determining node attributes based on node type and operation mode.
